editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
antibiotics <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")

gt(head(antibiotics))

ggplot(antibiotics, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "green") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("DID (standardised consumption)") +
  ggtitle("Rate of antibiotic consumption")
```
